title: Question security hardening, island territory mapping, and active player accounting
body:
QUESTION EXPLANATION SECURITY & ANTI-LEAK
- Prevented potential prompt plumbing and secret target name leaks in local question explanations using explanation sanitization.

KNOWLEDGE BASE & ROUTING ENHANCEMENTS
- Mapped island territory and archipelago questions directly to the verified is_island fact.
- Routed territory proportion questions (e.g., 'mostly in Europe') to general-knowledge fallback with a 50% threshold common-sense evaluation.
- Added rich factual explanations for mountain ranges in Województwodle.

GAME INITIALIZATION & PLAYER ACCOUNTING
- Ensured asking questions automatically initializes the daily game puzzle across regional modes if not already created.
- Fixed active players counting to accurately account for players participating in daily deduction games.
